newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble demand higher on month-end payments.
newsitem.headline: Rouble demand higher on month-end payments.

text.p: The rouble was little changed on Thursday as banks sought funds for themselves and their clients for month-end payments, dealers said.
"Banks and their client need roubles to square balances and pay taxes at the end of the month. This is why rouble credit rates are relatively high," a European Trade Bank dealer said.
Another dealer said rouble demand was likely to remain at the current level next week until the period for tax payments expires.

Roubles for today settlement were quoted at 5,451-54 per dollar compared with an early 5,452-54 and 5,446-49 late on Wednesday. Tomorrow roubles edged down to 5,456-59 per dollar from yesterday's late 5,453-57.
The central bank said it had set 5,451/5,461 as its bid and offer rates against the dollar on Thursday.
Overnight rouble credits yielded 30-45 percent compared with Wednesday's late 20-35 percent.
